verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Stripe Tax can return a taxability_reason for a calculated tax result and supports itemized reporting, but nowhere does it document an API mechanism to mark a customer or transaction as tax-exempt with a specified exemption reason, nor any linkage of that reason through to the filed return. Missing for 10: exemption-marking API/parameter, exemption certificate storage, and evidence the exemption reason propagates into reports and filed returns.
